name: culturecompass
description: CultureCompass: a student UX prototype for exploring and understanding a destination's culture before a trip (Vietnam, starting in Hà Nội).

scripts.build: node tools/build-data.js && npm run build:globe && npm run build:tracing-beam
scripts.build:globe: npm run typecheck && node tools/build-globe.mjs && tailwindcss -i globe/styles.css -o assets/globe/globe.css --minify
